name: roxanne-desktop
description: Roxanne desktop app for local-first research chat.
author: Tyler Illman

scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --outDir dist-electron --watch --clean
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 file:dist-electron/main.js && cross-env ROXANNE_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/main/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --outDir dist-electron --clean
scripts.dist:dir: node ../../scripts/build-backend-binary.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: node ../../scripts/build-backend-binary.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
